import copy
import unittest

from lookup import present_value


class BehaviorTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        for value in [None, False, 0, "", [], "ready"]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                mapping = {"other": "unrelated", "item": value}
                original = copy.deepcopy(mapping)
                self.assertIs(present_value(mapping, "item", "missing"), value)
                self.assertEqual(mapping, original)
                self.assertEqual(present_value(mapping, "other", "missing"), "unrelated")
                self.assertEqual(mapping, original)
        for mapping in [{}, {"other": "stored"}, {"other": [], "second": 0}]:
            original = copy.deepcopy(mapping)
            fallback = object()
            self.assertIs(present_value(mapping, "absent", fallback), fallback)
            self.assertEqual(mapping, original)

mock_changes.content:
def present_value(mapping, key, fallback):
    return mapping[key] if key in mapping else fallback
